base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-fe008f21.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The longest vertical stroke determines the color; ties favor color 2.
    longest = {2: 0, 4: 0}
    for c in range(len(grid[0])):
        for color in (2, 4):
            run = 0
            for row in grid:
                if row[c] == color:
                    run += 1
                    longest[color] = max(longest[color], run)
                else:
                    run = 0
    color = 4 if longest[4] > longest[2] else 2
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
'''
